reuse_policy: Adopt verified shared installations; preserve unrelated packages and project runtimes. No second permanent Codex installation.
verification_policy: Discovery proves installation identity only. Negotiated capabilities and real project evidence are required before a language or operation is delivered.

mcp.verification: Actual MCP handshake and navigation, diagnostic and disposable edit in two roots.

mcp.version_policy: Pinned published Windows x64 package; qualification and acquisition belong to the Rust owner.
runtime: Rust managed MCP adapter on Windows x64
mcp.verification: Real-root source oracles, full index, bounded watcher/catch-up, recovery and global lifecycle acceptance.
Authenticated existing endpoint or stdio using the same graph; explicit repo validation; saved graph preserved.

runtime: Native companion ONNX Runtime and cached OCR detector, recognizer and PaddleOCR dictionary
mcp.verification: Actual read, offline OCR and bounded interaction with a disposable owned target. Missing OCR artifacts are provisioned explicitly with recoverable file journals; session startup never downloads models.

languages.name: Python
languages.provision: Prefer an existing compatible Pyright installation; provision into shared Serena cache on explicit install only. Do not modify the project environment.

languages.name: Rust
